radius.$description: One corner radius app-wide. Every rounded surface uses radius.base; pills use radius.pill.

base.$description: The single corner radius for panels, controls, chips and highlights. Seed: docs-system --radius.

pill.$description: Fully round ends: toggles, sliders, dots, scrollbar thumbs.

none.$description: No border (borderless chips, hidden column rules).

ring.$description: Linked-panel ring, outline strokes, list circle markers.

rail.$description: Accent rails: callout tone rule, linked-panel pin, drop line.

offset.$description: Gap between a control and its focus outline.

glass.$description: Backdrop blur behind glass panels. Seed: --docs-lab-glass-blur.
